result.summary: The page is mostly clean, but the bottom navigation has a clear visual defect: a stray horizontal bar cuts through the third tab icon, making it look struck-through.

issues.description: In the bottom navigation bar, a thick dark horizontal bar overlaps the third icon (the bookmark/list icon), running through its middle and extending past its edges so the icon appears struck through or broken.
issues.suggestion: Remove the stray bar or move any active-tab indicator so it sits below the icon rather than intersecting it, and verify the icon renders cleanly at this size.
